notes: usageCount counts every occurrence of the exact name in src/**/*.{css,scss,ts,tsx} except CSS definitions (var() refs + string refs such as TS style keys / setProperty).
resolvedValue follows var() chains: same-file definition first, then global (figma-tokens.css / global.css), then any; unresolvable vars fall back to the var() fallback.
figmaSource maps a token to tokens/figma-tokens.json via com.figma.codeSyntax.Web; figmaValue shows the alias (e.g. {Color.Blue.50}) that figma-tokens.css flattened to a literal.
tokens/figma-tokens.json defines no CSS itself; it is the source that scripts/figma_tokens_to_css.py turns into src/styles/figma-tokens.css.
